About me

Download CV (PDF)

I teach machine learning, deep learning, pattern recognition and computer vision in the Department of CSE–AIML at Future Institute of Technology, Kolkata. I previously served as Professor and Head of Electrical Engineering at Future Institute of Engineering and Management.

Research interests

  • Facial expression recognition
  • Machine learning and pattern recognition
  • Target detection, recognition and tracking

Research

Funded project · Principal investigator

Traffic detection and vehicle counting

A 12-month project with the West Bengal Pollution Control Board and TERI to count vehicles by category and road type in Kolkata and Howrah using machine learning.

Student mentoring · DRDO DRUSE · 2018

Quadcopter prototype for activity detection

Mentored a finalist team and developed a Python deep-learning method for real-time activity detection and classification.

Student mentoring · INAE Youth Conclave · 2018

Automatic Smart Dustbin

Mentored the first-place team at the conclave organised by IIT Kharagpur. The project used a convolutional neural network to distinguish biodegradable, biomedical and non-biodegradable waste.

Student mentoring · Aero India · 2019

Aerial activity detection, classification and localisation

Mentored the team that placed sixth at the Aero India Student Pavilion in Bengaluru. Its quadcopter prototype combined deep learning and hybrid correlation filtering.

Research methods and figures

Hybrid regression for two-flavour quark matter

SHAP-guided feature selection and a Gaussian mixture model help distinguish crossover and first-order transitions. Multilayer perceptrons classify phases and predict transition temperatures. Kernel ridge regression refines the phase boundary.

Publication details Publisher article

Deep facial feature fusion and voting

Four feature representations from fine-tuned VGG-19 layers are reduced using principal component analysis. The final expression label is chosen by voting across the layer-specific predictions.

Publication details Full paper (PDF)

Phase-encoded autoencoders and correlation filters

Cascaded autoencoders learn compact phase representations for class-specific correlation filters. Kernel density estimates of peak-to-sidelobe ratios set adaptive decision thresholds for recognising faces under changing illumination.

Publication details Chapter at Springer

Unconstrained video filtering for face localisation

A three-dimensional extension of the UMACE filter uses the relationship between video frames. The peak of the resulting correlation volume identifies where and when a face appears.

Related publication

Nonlinear correlation filtering in class-specific subspaces

Combines pixel nonlinearities, class-specific projection and reconstruction, and phase correlation. The two filter responses are compared to sharpen the peak associated with the correct face class under varying illumination.

Related publication

Particle-swarm optimisation of a preferential correlator

A multiclass filter uses both target-class and other-class examples during synthesis. Particle-swarm optimisation tunes the trade-offs between genuine correlation peaks, false acceptances and class compactness.

Related publication

Regression-network preprocessing for correlation filters

A generalised regression neural network learns two preprocessing kernels. One emphasises contours and the other smooths noise before the frequency-domain correlation stage.

Related publication

Facial landmark localisation

Landmark filters learn from annotated training images. The desired response is a Gaussian peak centred on each landmark, such as an eye, the nose tip or the mouth centre. Correlation peaks then locate landmarks in the test image.

Related publication

Class-specific optimum filtering

Projects and reconstructs test faces in class-specific subspaces. The filter adapts to the reconstructed face, and phase correlation supports recognition across changes in lighting.

Related publication
